status: review-only; not wired into the build
policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the source-audited translation.

changes.TT3A/g0/r1: Some kind of compound. There are woods beyond the wire.
changes.TT3A/g0/r7: I take it out of my pocket.
changes.TT3A/g0/r10: Voice: Halt, or I'll shoot! Me: What?!
changes.TT3A/g0/r12: ………… Why does this keep happening to me?!
changes.TT3A/g0/r13: Soldier: Cougar, again? Two weeks in solitary!
changes.TT3A/g0/r14: TIME: JULY 1944 — LOCATION: POW CAMP, SOUTHERN GERMANY — NAME: COUGAR — RANK: U.S. AIR FORCE FIRST LIEUTENANT
changes.TT3A/g0/r15: Looks like I warped into Germany during World War II… and into a POW's body.
changes.TT3A/g0/r17: There's another room beyond this wall.
changes.TT3A/g0/r18: The place reeks of men's sweat.
changes.TT3A/g0/r19: Voice: Cougar, can you hear me? Me: Yeah. Voice: The moment you're released, escape. We'll make the arrangements on our end. Me: … Voice: With your intelligence, we can finally bring Hitler down!
changes.TT3A/g0/r20: Voice: Don't give up. The Allies are counting on you.
changes.TT3A/g0/r22: Maybe I should do some push-ups.
changes.TT3A/g0/r23: Soldier: All right. You're free to go. Me: Finally…
changes.TT3A/g0/r24: I grip it tightly. Somehow, I feel a little braver.
changes.TT3A/g0/r26: In fact, he's an intelligence agent.
changes.TT3A/g0/r28: Hitler: Great dark god… by the law of human fat and sharpened stakes, I pledge my entire life to you…
changes.TT3A/g0/r29: Devil: The pact is sealed. Your soul, in exchange for a portion of my power. And I, in turn…
changes.TT3A/g0/r30: Devil: Every new pact awakens more of my former power. Once it has all returned… Hitler: Then…! Devil: I will have my revenge on him! Hitler: …!
changes.TT3A/g0/r31: Hitler: Traitors in my own army are plotting to kill me. Please! Slaughter every last one of them! Devil: Don't get carried away. Do it yourself. Hitler: …
changes.TT3A/g1/r0: Soldier: Work detail's over. Back to your barracks!
changes.TT3A/g1/r5: Tiles cover the floor, with water running between them.
changes.TT3A/g1/r6: He smacks loudly as he chews his gum.
changes.TT3A/g1/r7: In profile, staring upward, he looks rugged.
changes.TT3A/g1/r8: His worn face shows how long he's been a prisoner.
changes.TT3A/g1/r9: Frankie: Take this… a pendant. My grandmother gave it to me before I went to war. It's a Romani charm. With this on, nothing scares me. I put it on. Frankie: Good luck…
changes.TT3A/g1/r13: Something is bulging beneath the sheet.
changes.TT3A/g1/r15: A faint light is shining from under the mattress.
changes.TT3A/g1/r17: There's writing on the star-shaped medal, but it's too corroded to read.
changes.TT3A/g1/r18: Nick: Tough luck, Cougar. Better luck next time.
changes.TT3A/g1/r19: Nick: The assassination attempt on Hitler failed. That bastard's got the devil's own luck.
changes.TT3A/g1/r21: Ralph: Head west through the woods until you reach a park. Ask Rebecca for your orders. Me: Rebecca?! Ralph: It's the network's code name. Password: "Drop dead, Hitler!"
changes.TT3A/g1/r22: "Drop dead, Hitler!" The Gestapo are everywhere. Be careful and don't attract attention.
changes.TT3A/g1/r24: Frankie: You're on your own. We'll pretend we know nothing. Don't hold it against us.
changes.TT3A/g1/r25: Frankie: Hitler rounds up spies and rebels and sends them to the gas chambers.
changes.TT3A/g1/r26: Frankie: America and Germany are racing to build some secret weapon—an atomic bomb. One of those could turn Paris to ash.
changes.TT3A/g2/r9: Clay soil. No good for pottery.
changes.TT3A/g2/r10: I dig up a little pebble.
changes.TT3A/g2/r14: The woods are only five meters away.
changes.TT3A/g2/r26: I made it out, changed clothes, and headed for the park. Before long, dawn broke.
changes.TT3A/g2/r29: He's holding a piece of paper. Simon: A child gave it to me. Some man I'd never seen asked him to deliver it. I take it. The writing is in blue ink.
changes.TT3A/g2/r30: A torn piece of a note, written in blue ink: "…4 km southwest…" "…Rebecca"
changes.TT3A/g2/r31: The other half of the note, also in blue ink: "…old watermill…" "…wait there…"
changes.TT3A/g3/r2: Man: Are you one of Rebecca's? Me: No. I escaped from the camp last night.
changes.TT3A/g3/r3: Man: I'm Simon, a physicist. I had contacts ask Rebecca's people to hide me…
changes.TT3A/g3/r4: Simon: The Nazis imprisoned me and forced me to develop a secret weapon. I will not help them murder anyone ever again!
changes.TT3A/g3/r8: Man: Thank goodness… I thought you'd abandoned me.
changes.TT3A/g3/r9: I give him a quick wink, then rub the tip of my nose twice. Man: What was that?!
changes.TT3A/g3/r10: Aw, man… these clothes are all wrinkled.
changes.TT3A/g3/r13: "Four kilometers southwest of here. Wait outside the old watermill. —Rebecca"
changes.TT3A/g3/r14: Simon: The Gestapo are nearby. We should stay here for now.
changes.TT3A/g3/r19: Man: My son was sixteen. They sent him to war, and the enemy shot him dead… You couldn't possibly understand what that does to a father.
changes.TT3A/g3/r20: Man: According to our information, an escape-network contact is coming through here. Have you seen anyone suspicious?
changes.TT3A/g3/r23: He takes off in a flash.
changes.TT3A/g3/r24: I reach down for the bottle. There's a piece of paper inside.
changes.TT3A/g3/r25: I smash the bottle and pull out the note. It's written in red ink.
changes.TT3A/g3/r27: Man: Don't move! Me: What?! Man: You idiot! I'm Gestapo!
changes.TT3A/g3/r28: Damn… after I came all this way…
changes.TT3A/g3/r29: I give him a quick wink, then rub the tip of my nose twice. Man: …
changes.TT3A/g4/r2: What was the Nazi secret police that purged Hitler's enemies?
changes.TT3A/g4/r4: What was the French resistance movement called?
changes.TT3A/g4/r5: What was Germany's famous class of submarine called?
changes.TT3A/g4/r6: Which big-nosed actor starred in "Pépé le Moko"?
changes.TT3A/g4/r7: Who commanded the Normandy landings later called "The Longest Day"?
changes.TT3A/g4/r8: Old Man: Correct! You got every one.
changes.TT3A/g4/r9: Old Man: By the way… do you know the Gestapo's recognition signal?
changes.TT3A/g4/r11: Old Man: Rub the tip of your nose twice with one finger.
changes.TT3A/g4/r12: Old Man: A barking dog does not always mean a thief. German proverb.
changes.TT3A/g4/r16: Woman: Until the war is over, love will have to wait…
changes.TT3A/g4/r17: Woman: A POW escaped, and a scientist fled an army laboratory. Have you seen anyone suspicious?
changes.TT3A/g4/r21: Woman: Hands up! Me: What?! Woman: Too bad. I'm Gestapo!
changes.TT3A/g4/r22: I give her a quick wink, then rub the tip of my nose twice. Woman: …
